integrity: Analytic proof covers all n>=3 and all t>0 including resonances; included finite checker is corroborative, and independent expert verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite weighted fans with unit path edges and a common positive spoke weight; exact fixed-coordinate Kalman determinant and vertex-input controllability, not optimal control energy, arbitrary heterogeneous networks or directed graphs. Specialist graph-join material was only partially accessible; overlap beyond inspected literature remains possible.
title: Exact Kalman determinants and resonant actuator placement on weighted fans
